name: Daitō (Shimane, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Daitō town emblem in red: a cherry blossom bearing the character 大 in white.
history: Flag of the former town of Daitō in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 6 November 1903.

features.role: Daitō town emblem — a cherry blossom bearing the character 大 in white
